name: University of California, Santa Barbara
character: The campus sits on cliffs above the Pacific Ocean with a beach, a lagoon, walking and bicycle paths, and buildings featuring custom-tinted patterned concrete blocks.

landmarks.name: Storke Tower
landmarks.quote: Storke Tower, completed in 1969, is the tallest steel/cement structure in Santa Barbara County.
landmarks.look: Tall steel and cement tower overlooking a plaza.

landmarks.name: Davidson Library
landmarks.quote: Situated at the center of campus, the Davidson Library in June 2013 broke ground
landmarks.look: Plain large library building at the center of campus.

landmarks.name: Campbell Hall
landmarks.quote: Campbell Hall is the university's largest lecture hall with 862 seats.

landmarks.name: Goleta Point
landmarks.quote: and the rocky extension, Goleta Point, which is also known as "Campus Point".
landmarks.look: Rocky coastline point extending into the Pacific Ocean.

landmarks.name: Storke Plaza
landmarks.quote: It can be seen from most places on campus, and it overlooks Storke Plaza.
landmarks.look: Open campus plaza beneath a tall tower.

landmarks.name: Arts Library
landmarks.quote: The UCSB Libraries, consisting of the Davidson Library and the Arts Library
